children: Greenland Mines shares rose after the company entered a securities agreement to sell and issue shares and warrants.
The stock gained 10% to $12.35 in after-hours trading Wednesday, after closing down 21%. Through the close, shares had lost 30% of their value this year.
The mining company said it would sell and issue 1.77 million shares, as well as pre-funded warrants exercisable for up to 1.43 million shares. The price is $12 a stock or warrant.
Proceeds from the offering are expected to be $38.4 million, after expenses. Greenland Mines plans to use the funds, together with existing cash, for its mining operations and general corporate uses.
The offering is slated to close on or about Sept. 24.
